item.title: Hibiscus Rose Petal Tea
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Hibiscus Rose Petal Tea combines vibrant hibiscus flowers with delicate rose petals, creating a visually stunning and flavorful experience. With a tangy, slightly tart flavor and a floral finish, this caffeine-free blend is ideal for hot or iced tea and is rich in antioxidants.

item.title: Matcha Green Tea Powder
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Our Matcha Green Tea Powder is made from high-quality, shade-grown green tea leaves, stone-ground into a fine powder. Known for its rich taste and high antioxidant content, matcha offers a smooth, earthy flavor with a natural sweetness. Perfect for traditional matcha tea or as an ingredient in lattes and smoothies.

item.title: Assam Breakfast Tea
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: A strong, malty black tea from the Assam region of India, this Breakfast Tea provides a full-bodied flavor that’s ideal for starting the day. Its rich, robust profile pairs well with milk and sugar for a classic breakfast tea experience.

item.title: Golden Turmeric Ginger Blend
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: A blend of turmeric, ginger, and warming spices, this caffeine-free infusion is both invigorating and grounding. Known for its anti-inflammatory properties, turmeric pairs with ginger for a robust and slightly spicy taste. Enjoy as a soothing tea or add steamed milk for a golden latte.

item.title: Chamomile Honey Delight
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Chamomile Honey Delight combines calming chamomile flowers with a touch of honey essence, creating a comforting, naturally sweet tea. This caffeine-free blend is ideal for winding down in the evening, with soothing properties that promote relaxation and restful sleep.

item.title: Organic Peppermint Bliss
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Refreshing and caffeine-free, Organic Peppermint Bliss is a pure herbal infusion made from high-quality peppermint leaves. Its invigorating aroma and cool minty flavor provide a natural pick-me-up, perfect for clearing the mind and soothing digestion. Enjoy hot or iced for a refreshing experience.

item.title: Chai Masala
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Inspired by traditional Indian recipes, our Chai Masala is a bold blend of black tea and spices like cinnamon, ginger, cardamom, and cloves. This warming tea offers a rich and spicy flavor with a hint of sweetness, perfect for cozying up on cold days. Add milk and sugar for a […]
item.content:encoded: Inspired by traditional Indian recipes, our Chai Masala is a bold blend of black tea and spices like cinnamon, ginger, cardamom, and cloves. This warming tea offers a rich and spicy flavor with a hint of sweetness, perfect for cozying up on cold days. Add milk and sugar for a classic chai experience.

item.title: Jasmine Green Tea
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: Our Jasmine Green Tea is a fragrant and soothing blend, featuring high-quality green tea leaves delicately scented with real jasmine blossoms. This aromatic tea is perfect for relaxation and offers a slightly sweet floral flavor that lingers with every sip. Ideal for unwinding at any time of the day.

item.title: Classic Earl Grey
item.dc:creator: teadrop host
item.description: A timeless blend of premium black tea infused with the delicate aroma of bergamot, Classic Earl Grey delivers a smooth and balanced taste with citrus notes and floral undertones. item.content:encoded: A timeless blend of premium black tea infused with the delicate aroma of bergamot, Classic Earl Grey delivers a smooth and balanced taste with citrus notes and floral undertones. Perfect for morning and afternoon tea, this blend pairs well with a slice of lemon or a splash of milk for a classic touch
